 LPG price jumps Tk 475 in two months, 12kg cylinder now Tk 2,060
 BERC announces second consecutive monthly hike, raising November price by Tk 223 
 Published : 2 November 2026
 • 
 Updated : 2 November 2026, 19:49
 • 
 POWER AND ENERGY
 SHARE 
 Star Online Report 
 The Bangladesh Energy Regulatory Commission (BERC) has raised the price of a 12kg liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) cylinder by Tk 223 to Tk 2,060 for November.
 The new price, announced by the energy regulator in its latest monthly adjustment, is up from Tk 1,837 in October .
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 In October, BERC had raised the price of a 12kg cylinder by Tk 252, to Tk 1,837.
 With the latest adjustment, the price of a 12kg LPG cylinder has increased by Tk 475 in two months.
 The price of autogas, the LPG used in vehicles, has also been raised by Tk 7.33 per litre, from Tk 84.62 to Tk 91.95.
